title: fix(app-shell): a chat pane too narrow for the preview split previews the way a phone does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8NKwKGQBkpf1QUFK6NsWFT5)_
Fixes #27420

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:助手聊天面板放不下「聊天 + 预览」并排(两者最小宽度合计 780px)时,改走手机端已有的预览方式:聊天占满宽度,输入框上方给「预览应用」按钮,预览以整块浮层打开,关闭回到聊天。780px 及以上保持原来的并排分栏和拖拽分隔条。
- 为什么改:1024px 窗口下应用内助手的草稿预览被挤出面板,380px 的 iframe 只露出 136px,客户看不到改动。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `AiChatPage.tsx` 的分栏判定(新增 `isTooNarrowForSplit` 与 `tooNarrow`,原 `isMobile` 的五处开关改读 `phonePreview`);宽度足够时行为不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`AiChatPage.tsx` 的 `useResizableChatPane` 新增的 `tooNarrow` 测量与 `phonePreview`;再看新测试 `AiChatPage.narrowSplit-27420.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.narrowSplit-27420.test.tsx`,预期 6 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` only, as the seat ruled on the card (reuse the phone path):

- **`isTooNarrowForSplit(containerWidth)`**, pure and exported beside `clampChatPaneWidth`: true below `CHAT_PANE_MIN_WIDTH + CHAT_PREVIEW_MIN_WIDTH` (780 px); an unmeasured container (0) is not narrow, the same convention `clampChatPaneWidth` uses.
- **`useResizableChatPane` returns `tooNarrow`.** It is read from the pane's own root (the existing `containerRef`, present in both presentations), in a layout effect with its own `ResizeObserver` that runs whether or not the split is open, so a narrow pane never paints the split first. The existing re-clamp observer is unchanged and still runs only while the split is open.
- **`phonePreview = isMobile || split.tooNarrow`** replaces `isMobile` at the five switch points: the beside-chat split (`desktopSplit`), the pill row (`mobilePreviewAvailable`), the two Preview-tap auto-opens, and the full-surface overlay (`ai-chat-mobile-canvas`). No new widget, no change to the dock's width or the app page beside it.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/clampChatPaneWidth.test.ts` gains the threshold cases; `AiChatPage.narrowSplit-27420.test.tsx` is new. One patch changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`).

## Why

#27420: in the console dock at a 1024 px window the dock is maximized to 504 px while a preview is open, the chat column keeps its 360 px floor and is `shrink-0`, and the Live Canvas is laid out past the dock's edge.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured in real Chromium** (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, 768 px tall), on the real `ChatDockPanel` with the real `useChatDockState` (so the canvas auto-maximize is real), the real `ChatDockConversation`, `ChatPane`, `ChatbotEnhanced` and `LiveCanvas`, served by the console's own Vite config with its Tailwind sheet. Fixtures: the app page beside the rail is a `min-w-0 flex-1` box; the chat hooks are inert and a hidden handle calls `onPreviewDraftApp` as a draft card's Preview does (the stand-ins of `AiChatPage.previewPillInFlow-13068.test.tsx`); the agent catalog, metadata, adapter and auth hooks are stubbed. The harness was scratch and is not committed. "Before" is this branch with the switch ablated back to `isMobile` alone.

  | Window | Dock | Before: presentation · preview iframe x-range · visible | After: presentation · preview iframe x-range · visible |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | 1024 | 504 | split · 888–1221 · **136 px** | overlay · 522–1024 · 502 px (whole) |
  | 1280 | 760 | split · 888–1280 · 392 px (preview below its 420 px minimum) | overlay · 522–1280 · 758 px (whole) |
  | 1440 | 920 | split · 888–1440 · 552 px | split · 888–1440 · 552 px (unchanged) |

  The 1024 reading reproduces the card's figures (iframe from x 888, 136 px visible). `document.scrollWidth` equals the window width in every row.
- **The dock keeps the split only from a 1300 px window.** The maximized dock is the window minus the 520 px the page beside it keeps (`maximizedDockWidth`), so the 780 px threshold is a 1300 px window. At 1280 px the dock now takes the phone path where it used to show a squeezed (not clipped) split. That follows the ruled threshold; recorded here so the seat sees it.
- **Other hosts of the same pane follow the same rule.** The full-page `/ai` chat keeps its split whenever its pane is at least 780 px (pinned at 780 px in the new test); the Studio copilot's narrow slot, which also mounts `ChatPane`, now previews through the overlay instead of overflowing.
- **No flip-flop.** The width is read from the pane root, whose width the presentation does not change (the overlay is `absolute inset-0` inside it, the split's children are inside it too). The new test replays resizes across the threshold and repeats each width (779, 780) to show a held width never switches back.
- An auto-drafted preview (an artifact landing, not a Preview tap) in a narrow pane offers the pill without covering the chat, as on a phone.

## Verification

Head `605e6e5c` (branch merged with `origin/main` `bbb49c9f`); every reading below is from that tree.

- New pins: `AiChatPage.narrowSplit-27420.test.tsx` 6/6 and `clampChatPaneWidth.test.ts` 8/8 passed.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `const phonePreview = isMobile || split.tooNarrow;` replaced by `const phonePreview = isMobile;`, landed 1 to 0): the new suite went red, 3 failed (both 760 px cases and the resize case), 3 passed (the 780 px and unmeasured cases, which do not depend on it). Restored: blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ packages/app-shell/src/layout/`: 165 files, 1024 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new. `pnpm check:changeset-fixed`: exit 0.
